description.text: This program is divided into beginner, intermediate and advanced levels with each level further divided into 3 levels to allow students at similar Chinese levels to be grouped together. Each class consists of 10-18 students. The curriculum focuses on listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills, modern grammar and essay writing. Application Period · April – August 31st for Fall Semester: · October – November 30 for Spring Semester: Tuition · CNY 9,900/person for the first semester, and CNY 9,100/person for each subsequent semester · Note: Advance payment of CNY 2,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester. Certificate · Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion.

duration.text: The Elementary Chinese Training Program at University of International Business and Economics is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1375 USD/per semester ￥ 9900 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be in good health 2.High school diploma 3.Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial deed of guardianship
